_readme: S644, 2026-11-13. Diablo Valley's eLumen catalog names no program (S394 reads 38670917323, 38672223676, 38672391389; S402 run 38999074345) and points to www.dvc.edu/programs. This read loads that page once, prints its text and the links into program pages, the catalog, a PDF or a program map, and records the data its own scripts fetch. No model call.

questions.program_list: Does www.dvc.edu/programs list the college's programs, and what is one program page's address?
questions.requirements_home: Does a program page print its courses and units, or link elsewhere (a PDF, an eLumen address, a program map)?
